data.title: ASU a partner in new national Foundry School announced by White House
data.description: A national initiative to train the next wave of workers in American manufacturing has chosen Arizona State University as one of its flagship institutions. This initiative, led by the U.S. Department of State, aims to strengthen the workforce in this critical sector. ASU is one of eight universities selected for this program, highlighting its dedication to preparing skilled professionals for the industry. The initiative, known as The Foundry School, launched on September 4, 2026. This selection underscores ASU's commitment to innovative education and its role in shaping the future workforce.

data.title: Football Is Back: Raiders Bring the Drama and Passion of Raider Nation to Life in Mexico
data.description: With the resumption of football activities, the Raiders have announced the release of the concluding episodes of Corazón de Plata y Negro, a telenovela-themed series that portrays the emotions and fervor of being a fan in an engaging manner. Julio Bracho and Jimena Sánchez recently participated in NFL Mexico's NFL Kickoff Event, where they joined the Raider Nation community to introduce the final chapters of the series. This event witnessed a significant turnout, with an impressive number of fans showing up to celebrate the beloved sport.

data.title: M.C. Layman Marks Two Years as Founder Kate Layman Joins Two Frederick County Boards
data.description: In Frederick, Maryland, on September 4, 2026, Kate Layman, the founder of M.C. Layman, celebrates the company's two-year anniversary. She has taken on two new leadership positions within the Frederick community. Layman has been named to the Board of Directors of Woodsboro Bank, making significant strides since the company's establishment.

data.title: Hornbeck Announces New Employee Inducement Grant Under NYSE Rule 303A.08
data.description: On September 4, 2026, it was reported that Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. (NYSE: HOS), a leading offshore services firm, disclosed details regarding its merger with Helix Energy Solutions Group, Inc. The merger is set to bring together two prominent companies in the industry, with significant implications for stakeholders. The integration process is expected to result in various operational changes and strategic realignments that could potentially reshape the offshore services sector. Both companies are known for their expertise and market presence, making this merger a notable development in the field. The merger between Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. and Helix Energy Solutions Group, Inc. is anticipated to have far-reaching effects on the offshore services market, with implications for investors, employees, and industry competitors.

data.title: Astra from OpenAI achieves Critical cybersecurity level with strong safeguards following Preparedness Framework. Read more.
data.description: Astra, developed by OpenAI, has achieved a significant milestone by becoming the initial AI model to attain Critical level cybersecurity capability as per the Preparedness Framework. This achievement has led to the implementation of strict protective measures to safeguard the AI model.

data.title: Potomac Edison Proposes Rate Adjustment to Support Electric System Reliability
data.description: Potomac Edison, a subsidiary of FirstEnergy Corp., has proposed a rate adjustment in Maryland on September 4, 2026. This adjustment would help in maintaining low residential electric rates. It is aimed at supporting ongoing investments in the electric sector. Despite this adjustment, the residential electric rates are expected to remain the most competitive among Maryland investor-owned utilities. Potomac Edison aims to continue its commitment to providing affordable electricity to its customers.

data.title: Cheche Group Reports First Half 2026 Unaudited Financial Results
data.description: Beijing, September 4, 2026 - Cheche Group Inc. revealed its unaudited financial results for the first six months of 2026. Operating as China's primary auto insurance technology platform, the company, listed as NASDAQ: CCG, shared key business achievements. These include successful partnerships with significant new entities.

data.title: Postpartum Support International Calls for Reform as Lindsay Clancy Case Ends in Mistrial
data.description: On September 4, 2026, in Portland, Oregon, Postpartum Support International, a prominent nonprofit organization focused on perinatal mental health, emphasized the significance of the trial of Lindsay Clancy for first-degree murder. The organization stressed the importance of addressing a challenging reality as a society in response to this case.

data.title: Midea Brings "Simply ideal" to Life at IFA 2026
data.description: In Berlin on September 4, 2026, Midea showcased their latest innovations at IFA 2026, embodying their vision of "Simply ideal" by focusing on enhancing intelligence, comfort, efficiency, and convenience in homes. The event unveiled Midea's new five-year partnership with FC, demonstrating their commitment to advancing technology and home solutions.

data.title: KB HOME OPENS SANDSTONE, A NEW MASTER-PLANNED COMMUNITY OF OVER 1,500 HOMES IN A PRIME NORTH LAS VEGAS LOCATION
data.description: A new master plan unveiled in North Las Vegas includes four affordable communities priced from the $300,000s. The plan also includes over 12 acres dedicated to parks and trails. KB Home, a leading U.S. homebuilder, made the announcement on Sept. 4, 2026.

data.title: Jeulia Jewelry Celebrates 12 Years with "Pick Your Sparkle" Interactive Campaign Inviting Fans to Vote for its Most Iconic Design
data.description: To celebrate its 12th anniversary, a well-known jewelry company specializing in affordable luxury is asking customers to pick their favorite designs that embody the essence of the Jeulia brand. In conjunction with this milestone, they have unveiled a new collection called Gothic Romance. This update was shared from New York on September 4, 2026, through a press release.

data.title: Bank of America Announces Redemptions of $500,000,000 Floating Rate Senior Notes and $1,500,000,000 5.933% Fixed/Floating Rate Senior Notes, Due September 2027
data.description: In Charlotte, North Carolina, on September 4, 2026, Bank of America Corporation revealed its plan to redeem all $500,000,000 principal amount of Floating Rate Senior Notes due September 2027 (CUSIP No. 06051GLX5) on September 15, 2026.

data.title: Strong US job growth in August surprises markets, pushes Bitcoin below $80K amid speculation of Federal Reserve rate cut.
data.description: In August, the US economy saw a significant increase in job creation, surpassing expectations. This development led to a drop in the value of Bitcoin as traders adjusted their predictions for a potential interest rate cut by the Federal Reserve later this month. The strong job growth numbers influenced market sentiment and potentially altered the likelihood of Fed actions in the near future.

data.title: Arcosa Stockholders Approve Acquisition by CRH
data.description: The company Arcosa, Inc. (NYSE: ACA), a provider of infrastructure products, has received approval from its stockholders for acquisition by CRH (NYSE: CRH) at a special meeting on September 4, 2026. The merger agreement entails CRH acquiring 100% of Arcosa. The final voting results will be shared by Arcosa on a Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

data.title: TOP Financial Group Limited Announces Strategic Relocation of Global Headquarters to the United States
data.description: Houston, Texas, September 4, 2026 - TOP Financial Group Limited (NASDAQ: TOP), a rapidly expanding online brokerage firm specializing in domestic and international equities, futures, and options, has disclosed its decision to move its global headquarters to the United States. This move signifies a significant advancement in the company's enduring growth plan, indicating a gradual transition of its main corporate attention and operational presence to the American market. The new location for the headquarters will be 4201 Main Street, Suite 200, Houston, Texas 77002.

data.title: Bright Minds Biosciences to Present at Upcoming Conferences
data.description: On September 4, 2026, Bright Minds Biosciences, Inc. (NASDAQ: DRUG) unveiled its plans to participate in key conferences. The innovative company, known as Bright Minds or BMB, is dedicated to creating advanced 5-HT2 agonists for drug-resistant epilepsy, Prader-Willi Syndrome, depression, and various CNS disorders. They will partake in events focusing on these critical health areas.
